decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf sits at the core of the firm's heritage bread range and cost little to sustain, so management keeps it despite no visible evidence of success.
The mill tour builds on sunk investments in hospitality facilities and showcases the firm's tradition publicly, so pandemic-related weakness is attributed to temporary causes and the tour is kept.
The sweet pastry belongs to the established confectionery offer, and any weak results can be blamed on temporary market disruptions, so management persists with it.
The crusty farmhouse bread fits the traditional bread line with low incremental cost, so there is little pressure to drop it.
The poppy seed stollen is the firm's publicly presented flagship with a gold award, so management is strongly committed to keeping it.
The premium stollen won a gold award and anchors the lucrative seasonal Christmas business, so management keeps it.
